title: The Mystery of Anesthesia: Switching Off a Mind We Don't Understand
question: How can anesthesiologists reliably turn consciousness off and on again when science still can't say what consciousness is?
summary: General anesthesia is one of medicine's great practical triumphs and one of neuroscience's deepest embarrassments: it works on tens of millions of people every year, yet nobody can fully explain how a handful of small molecules reversibly erase a mind.
